title: Two new image models joined the garden
summary:
New image models, smarter concurrency, and a round of observability work made the garden more useful and less mysterious.

Nanobanana and Seedream are now available through the image service, alongside corrected provider mapping and tracking headers so image requests reach the infrastructure they are meant to reach and remain easier to trace.

Model improvements landed with tier-aware concurrency controls and rate-limit monitoring, giving the platform a clearer view of demand while keeping model access orderly when the queue gets lively.

Telemetry now preserves error events when cost resolution is unavailable, text moderation outcomes are tracked, and a staging deployment plus an environment-file hotfix make it safer to test changes before they wander into production.

highlights.title: GPT-5 Arrives
highlights.text: The `openai` and `openai-fast` endpoints are now powered by GPT-5 Mini and Nano models. [Text API](https://enter.pollinations.ai)

highlights.title: 4K Image Generation
highlights.text: Added `seedream` (ByteDance ARK 4.0) for 4K images and `nanobanana` (Gemini 2.5 Flash). [Image API](https://enter.pollinations.ai)

highlights.title: DeepSeek V3.1
highlights.text: The powerful DeepSeek V3.1 model is now available via the text API.

highlights.title: Reference Images
highlights.text: You can now use reference images in the editor and API to guide generation style and composition.

highlights.title: Live Search
highlights.text: The `gemini-search` model now features automatic Google Search grounding for real-time answers.
